To evaluate the quality of the generated text, we design an agent to reflect and perform evaluations. This evaluation process employs prompting to facilitate step-by-step reasoning. The assessment focuses on two key criteria: Incorrect Information: Evaluating whether the generated text accurately reflects the facts derived from the provided knowledge. Any discrepancies or inconsistencies are flagged for re-generation. Label Alignment: Measuring the degree of alignment between the generated text and the corresponding ground truth label, ensuring consistency and relevance to the intended output.
